title: Trustee's skills.
bodyText: A trustee who has special skills or expertise or is named trustee in reliance upon the trustee's representation that the trustee has special skills or expertise shall use those special skills or expertise.
bodyHtml: [§554D-806]  Trustee's skills.  A trustee who has special skills or expertise or is named trustee in reliance upon the trustee's representation that the trustee has special skills or expertise shall use those special skills or expertise. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
